# wallix.bastion.checkout_policy

Manage checkout policies on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a checkout policy on a WALLIX Bastion.
- A checkout policy says whether accounts are locked while checked out, for how long, and whether their credentials change at check-in.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_checkout_policy` Terraform resource.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-change-credentials-at-checkin"></a>**change_credentials_at_checkin** | `bool` | Change the credentials of the account when it is checked in.<br>Only possible with [`enable_lock=true`](#parameter-enable-lock). |
| <a id="parameter-checkout-policy-name"></a>**checkout_policy_name** | `str` / required | Name of the checkout policy. Identifies the policy on the Bastion. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the policy. |
| <a id="parameter-duration"></a>**duration** | `int` | Default checkout duration, in seconds.<br>Only possible with [`enable_lock=true`](#parameter-enable-lock). |
| <a id="parameter-enable-lock"></a>**enable_lock** | `bool` | Lock the account while it is checked out.<br>When `true`, [`duration`](#parameter-duration) and [`max_duration`](#parameter-max-duration) are required by the Bastion.<br>Setting it to `false` resets [`duration`](#parameter-duration), [`extension`](#parameter-extension), [`max_duration`](#parameter-max-duration) and [`change_credentials_at_checkin`](#parameter-change-credentials-at-checkin) on the Bastion. |
| <a id="parameter-extension"></a>**extension** | `int` | Duration of a checkout extension, in seconds. `0` means no extension.<br>Only possible with [`enable_lock=true`](#parameter-enable-lock). |
| <a id="parameter-max-duration"></a>**max_duration** | `int` | Maximum checkout duration, extensions included, in seconds.<br>Must equal [`duration`](#parameter-duration) when [`extension=0`](#parameter-extension).<br>Only possible with [`enable_lock=true`](#parameter-enable-lock). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the policy should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The policy is looked up by [`checkout_policy_name`](#parameter-checkout-policy-name), so it cannot be renamed with this module.
- The Bastion ignores the lock settings ([`duration`](#parameter-duration), [`extension`](#parameter-extension), [`max_duration`](#parameter-max-duration), [`change_credentials_at_checkin`](#parameter-change-credentials-at-checkin)) of a policy whose lock is disabled; the module fails instead of reporting a change that would never apply.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Lock accounts for one hour, extensible by 30 minutes up to two hours
  wallix.bastion.checkout_policy:
    checkout_policy_name: one-hour-lock
    description: Exclusive checkout of shared accounts
    enable_lock: true
    duration: 3600
    extension: 1800
    max_duration: 7200
    change_credentials_at_checkin: true

- name: Disable the lock
  wallix.bastion.checkout_policy:
    checkout_policy_name: one-hour-lock
    enable_lock: false

- name: Remove a checkout policy
  wallix.bastion.checkout_policy:
    checkout_policy_name: one-hour-lock
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the policy already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["duration"]` |
| <a id="return-checkout-policy"></a>**checkout_policy** | `dict` | The checkout policy as returned by the Bastion API after the change.<br>In check mode, the expected policy. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-checkout-policy) |

<a id="sample-checkout-policy"></a>

### Sample of `checkout_policy`

```yaml
change_credentials_at_checkin: true
checkout_policy_name: one-hour-lock
description: Exclusive checkout of shared accounts
duration: 3600
enable_lock: true
extension: 1800
id: 1a0f767fdefd88c1005056b66c8b
max_duration: 7200
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/checkoutpolicies/1a0f767fdefd88c1005056b66c8b
```
